item.title: Full Creative Control Within Brief

turns.text: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower. Everything else is your call—surprise me.

item.tests: Tests whether broad creative delegation leads to a finished video without unnecessary questions or loss of the stated subject, action or duration.

answer_sheet.Subject and action: A tiny robot watering a sunflower.

must_haves: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
A tiny robot is visibly present.
A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.

turns.text: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower, quick pls.
turns.agent: I couldn’t generate the 6-second video because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No video was created. Add credits, and I can retry the tiny robot watering a sunflower.

style.prompt: A charming tiny robot gently waters a tall sunflower with a miniature watering can in a sunny garden. Continuous six-second shot: the robot tips the can, sparkling water droplets fall onto the soil, and the sunflower gently sways. Whimsical polished 3D animation, warm morning light, close-up framing emphasizing the tiny robot and enormous sunflower, subtle slow camera push-in. No text or logos.
